what: An ambient instrument. ALIGN writes a whole 4-track piece in one of 13 moods (always in key); AUTO keeps it growing from your own pattern, parts fading in and out; KEYS SHIFT moves the song to the nearest scale when you play out of it; SKY's macros, a 12-mode three-head SPACE TAPE echo with spring, and visions (cymatics, harmonograph, attractor, orrery) drawn from the music.
author: Polaris Sound Lab
sounds: CC0: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL samples (piano, flute, sax, kept from Felucca); the ambient presets and the FM voice bank are own
